title: 4Frames
description: Really decent fps modpack. Things like pvp and ping or fps it has all. There is mods that allow the player to do fast pickups from chest or shulkers with SHIFT+LEFT CLICK and there is optimazations that are client side like knockback optimizer.
body:
This has everything you need for the best feel and the best pvp optimzations. There are mods like perfect reach which shows a bar for the 3 block hit. There is also a built-in fullbright which you can change the keybind to whatever you desire. There is network optimizations like packet fixer or redirect (Mainly memory but a bit of network) There is alot more like pladduim for fps. There is Qol features. The purpose of this project was to give modpacks to poeple who dont want to do all of the work, so i fixed that with this mod that is used alot by people.
I will be making more in the future. A reason i think people would try this is since i have been studing mods for months as im a new player and want to help people over time. And the mods i pick are part of a category i use to give the best of the best. And to be honest this modpack is not perfect. Its just a better version then my old ones and this modpack gave me fps i could believe to be true (500 fps while pvping with rtx 3050 and i7 13650hx laptop)
so please dont think this is perfect and will make more fps then any other modpacks.
